title: Broadcom Stock News (Oct 15, 2026): AVGO Falls 3.1% to $346.25
summary: Broadcom (AVGO) fell 3.10% to $346.25 on Oct 14, 2026 as chip stocks slid after CEO Hock Tan flagged AI financing costs as a possible limit on growth.
body_markdown:
## Why Broadcom Stock Fell


As reported by[GuruFocus](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/nvidia-broadcom-marvell-stocks-fall-191611708.html) , Nvidia, Broadcom and Marvell fell as AI spending concerns grew, centered on Hock Tan's remarks that financing access and funding costs "might become key limits on growth of artificial-intelligence." Tan also reportedly said some parts of the AI business "have come to resemble gambling."


GuruFocus noted that AI data centers cost billions of dollars before customers earn a return, so higher financing costs could make some projects unprofitable, and that Broadcom is directly exposed as a supplier of custom AI chips and networking technology to hyperscale cloud providers. The same report said Tan's comments do not mean AI spending is about to fall.


## AVGO Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- According to[TheStreet](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/10-000-broadcom-investment-2016-221700178.html) , Broadcom reported record fiscal third quarter revenue of $29.6 billion, up 86% year over year, as AI chip sales more than tripled to $16.7 billion.
- TheStreet also reports that free cash flow hit a record $13.7 billion in the quarter, and the $2.60 annual dividend carries a payout ratio of about 25% and a[dividend yield](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/learn/dividend-yield-meaning-and-formula/) of 0.73%.


### Risks


- Customer concentration: TheStreet notes Broadcom relies on six custom chip customers, which it describes as heavy customer concentration risk.
- Financing exposure: GuruFocus noted that higher financing costs could make some AI data center projects unprofitable, and that Broadcom is directly exposed as a supplier of custom AI chips and networking technology to hyperscale cloud providers.


Broadcom's fourth quarter results are due December 9, according to TheStreet.
